steps: Triangles are continuation patterns: they reflect pauses before the primary trend resumes
Symmetrical Triangle: Converging upper and lower trendlines requiring minimum 4 contact points
The Apex Time Rule: Decisive breakouts must occur between 2/3 and 3/4 distance to the apex
Volume Behavior: Volume steadily contracts inside the coil and MUST surge on an upward breakout
Ascending Triangle: Flat upper horizontal resistance + rising lower trendline = Bullish bias
Descending Triangle: Flat lower horizontal support + falling upper trendline = Bearish bias
Measuring Techniques: Project the vertical base height from breakout point or use parallel channels
Broadening Formation: Diverging trendlines with expanding volume signal dangerous, uncontrolled tops
ui_state.bottomTakeaway: Respect the 2/3 to 3/4 apex window: true triangle breakouts pack volume before price hits the corner.
